tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Débora speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You give Thornfield 1,579 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. June weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Débora speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
You accept Emberhold's food — 2,423 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Oscar clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Hana.
You give Thornfield 1,862 kcal from Haven's bins — real food, honestly counted. June weeps, openly. "The fire network. That's what it's FOR." (Trust +4. They owe you — the ledger remembers.)
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
📓 Codex: you've heard of Harvest Table. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Cheyenne — Combat 1. Three offers; they took Harvest Table. Earned, chosen. (harvest_table: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Cheyenne chose Harvest Table (harvest_table) at Combat 1.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table — 4 people, 37 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 9 plants — 9 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southeast ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)
In The Red Table, mothers tell the story of the night you stood between. The children ask for it by name.
🗣️ Cheyenne to Colton, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

The southeast ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
⛓️ Diana brings it home: The Red Table bows to Haven — one organization, us primary. Tribute: 4,000 kcal/week. The relationship starts at trust 30. Everything from here is earned.
⛓️ Word of Haven's standing reaches The Red Table before any speaker does — they send word back: they will bow to Haven. One organization, us primary.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/11/6), with 3 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table notes 1 ascension from one village — its terms improve accordingly. Nobody has ever seen that before.

◈ THE BELOVED — The audience is chanting. You don't know the words — it isn't a language with words — but you know the feeling. The table can't move against the cast's favorite. That's leverage. Tonight, the cast is your village.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.

The show becomes the government. Strange. It works. Trillions of viewers hold the table to account in real time, and humanity's seat is wherever the cameras are. You made popularity into a constitution — and constitutions, unlike ratings, don't dip.
The terms held — the table had priced the village, ascension and all, and the village paid in full.
